text: The rats in the lower districts have grown larger. Something in the water.
A merchant caravan found a shortcut through the marshlands. No bloom sightings.
Winter is coming early this year. The white storms will close the mountain passes.
Scavengers found intact imperial weaponry in the Broken Engine lower levels.
The Salted Hound is calling in every tab this week. The owner looks frightened.
A night market trades in things that should not be sold. It moves each time it's found.
Strange lights flicker in the Broken Engine at night, in a rhythm like breathing.
A whole expedition crew walked into the boneyard and never came back out.
A peddler sells 'bloom-ward charms.' They are painted river stones, nothing more.
Children sing a new rhyme about a name no adult will repeat aloud.
